03134 Yow`ezer {yo-eh'-zer}

源自 03068 and 05828; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Joezer 1; 1

約以謝 = "耶和華是幫助"
1) 可拉人, 大衛王的大能勇士之一，於洗革拉投入大衛的麾下 （#代上 12:6|）
record.edic_text:
03134 Yow`ezer {yo-eh'-zer}

from 03068 and 05828;; n pr m

AV - Joezer 1; 1

Joezer = "Jehovah is help"
1) a Korhite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag
